system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
you can define a subclass of `ToolMessage` (pydantic based)
and it is transpiled into system prompt instructions for the tool.
system_prompt_style.note: System message is user-supplied per Task; tool instructions are appended depending on enabled tools. Quote spans a line break in the source.

env_context_strategy.note: The evidence is a general framework README and docs without source code. No default environment-context mechanism is shown. DocChatAgent RAG is an opt-in special agent.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Langroid tries to shorten the message history by dropping early messages
context_compaction.note: Default behaviour is truncate_oldest. Tool-result truncation is opt-in per ToolMessage (0.22.0: 'Optional parameters to truncate large tool results').

observation_format.evidence_quote: Allow tool handlers to return arbitrary result type, including other tools.
observation_format.note: Tool handler results are returned as message content. Multimodal inputs (0.52.0) cover user inputs, not observations.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Langroid supports OpenAI's [function calling](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/gpt/function-calling), as
well as an equivalent `ToolMessage` mechanism which works with
any LLM, not just OpenAI's.
tool_call_format.note: Also supports XMLToolMessage (0.17.0). The default is set by ChatAgentConfig use_tools / use_functions_api; the default value is not shown in the evidence. Quote spans line breaks in the source.

tool_count.note: No default tool list is shown. Tools are enabled per agent through enable_message.

edit_primitive.note: A tool registry is not in the evidence. The README mentions an EditTool but gives no definition.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
converts
the server's tools into Langroid's `ToolMessage` instances.
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas are derived from Pydantic ToolMessage classes, per the README: 'implemented using Pydantic'. Quote spans a line break in the source.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP Support: Allow any LLM-Agent to leverage MCP Servers

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
sub-tasks are simply additional responders, to be used in a round-robin fashion
after the agent's own responders.
loop_primitives.note: Task loop iterates over the LLM, agent and user responders. The run_batch_task option stop_on_first_result suggests multi_attempt. Quote spans a line break in the source.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Task class wraps an Agent, and gives the agent instructions (or roles, or goals)
planning_granularity.note: No plan object appears in the core. Planner workflows exist only as examples.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each of these `Task`s automatically configures a default `ChatAgent`.
multi_agent_topology.note: A default Task holds one agent. Hierarchical sub-task delegation is reachable through add_sub_task and TaskTool.

delegation_mechanism.note: Default is none. subagent_spawn is available opt-in through TaskTool, and sub-task handoff through add_sub_task.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
With this setting, the task loop waits for user input after
either the `llm_response` or `agent_response`
human_in_loop.note: Default interactive=True sets the user as a responder after each response. The interactive=False setting is configurable. The value fit is approximate. Quote spans a line break in the source.

short_term_state.note: GlobalState is available as an option.

long_term_memory.note: The vector store is optional per agent.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Currently there is no built-in Langroid mechanism for this
state_persistence.note: Manual pickling of message_history is possible. Portable JSON chat-history snapshots were added in 0.66.0.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: ensures that tool generation errors are sent back to the LLM so it retries the generation
retry_policy.note: This is a step-level requery, not a task retry.

rollback.evidence_quote:
`RewindTool`,
that lets an agent "rewind and redo" a past message
rollback.note: RewindTool rewinds conversation messages, not files. Quote spans a line break in the source.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
have `max_cost`
and `max_tokens` params to exit when tokens or cost exceed a limit.
termination_condition.note: Evidence also covers done_sequences, infinite loop detection and turns. Quote spans a line break in the source.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Langroid supports [Redis](https://redis.com/try-free/) to cache LLM responses.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
the Agent's function-handling method
executes the code and returns the answer.
execution_isolation.note: Tool handlers run in-process in Python. Quote spans a line break in the source.

tracing.evidence_quote: HTML Logger for interactive task visualization

guardrails.evidence_quote: generalized taint propagation across tool re-emission paths

target_domain.evidence_quote: Python framework to easily build LLM-powered applications
